verdict.rationale: Greptile documents autonomous background work: it automatically reviews every pull request with configurable triggers, auto-generates tests and diagrams per PR, and runs PR branches in a sandbox (TREX). It can also run in CI via an API key, and a community user confirms reviews land on PRs before human review. The automation is limited to the PR-review pipeline rather than user-defined background automations. missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations (custom workflows, schedules or event triggers beyond PR review), documented autonomous fix loops that run without a user launching them, independent corroboration of TREX and auto-test generation.
